title: Kerf UI component-props curated overlay
description: Hand-curated additions merged into the generated component-props.json: what types cannot express. Keys must name generated components and props.

groups.description: Inspector group names in display order.

control.description: Inspector control hint for an editor.

group.description: Inspector group: one of the families Content, Appearance, Behavior, Layout, Accessibility, Integration, or a name in groups.

subgroup.description: A component-specific task inside the group (Link, Typing assistance), shown under its own heading.

default.description: A default the types and JSDoc do not state.

choicesFrom.description: A value prop's options list: the name of the sibling list prop whose items' `value` and `label` an editor offers for it (a ColorSwatches `swatches`). Without it, an editor reads `choices`.
